title: Restore original productdb and remove temporary PostgreSQL container
scope: Use the existing localhost:5432/productdb database and remove only the container proven to publish host port 55432.
plan: Read-only inspect both PostgreSQL containers, including identity, image, database environment, and storage mounts; never stop or recreate my_postgres_db.
Stop the backend currently using the temporary service, remove only pm_postgres by container identity, and preserve its named volume.
Confirm dotenv.env already targets localhost:5432/productdb; make no configuration change unless required.
Start the backend on the existing :8090 port with DATABASE_URL targeting localhost:5432/productdb and verify process environment and database connectivity.
Verify GET / and GET /api/health return 200 and perform the authorized root login without exposing credentials, hashes, cookies, or tokens.
Run go test ./... and the shared documentation generator/tests; report any unavailable credential or test dependency as a blocker.
safety: Do not stop, delete, recreate, or modify my_postgres_db; do not delete any volume, image, database, or data.
